newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends slightly up in kerb.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends slightly up in kerb.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.01 up at 41.18 to the dollar in kerb market on Monday while the supply of the U.S. currency remained high, but would take a dip in the near term, dealers said.
"In the international market, the dollar has firmed against most currencies and this trend will be reflected here as well," a dealer said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.60 percent down from 2.70 on Saturday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
